title: What I Think, and So
label: ch:ml-what-i-think-and-so
canDo: I can say what I think with ennŭ ñān vicārikkunnu, karutunnu or enikkŭ tōnnunnu, and draw a result with atukoṇṭŭ.

payoff.summary: Complete ML-R341-opinion-and-result: an opinion three ways, a reason before its result with atukoṇṭŭ, and the new letter ഐ.
